We're Hiring | Non- Projects Procurement & Administration Manager | Emaar India | Gurgaon At Emaar India , we are looking for an experienced Non-Projects Procurement & Administration Professional to drive strategic sourcing, vendor management, and procurement operations across corporate functions. About the Role As a Non- Projects Procurement & Administration Manager , you will be responsible for managing end-to-end procurement, contract administration, vendor management, commercial negotiations, and sourcing activities across multiple business functions while ensuring governance, compliance, and cost optimization. What You'll Do ✅ Manage end-to-end non-projects procurement lifecycle including RFQs/RFPs, vendor evaluation, commercial negotiations, and purchase orders. ✅ Handle procurement for: Marketing & Branding Event Management HR & Administration Customer Service Legal & Compliance Facilities Management IT Consumables & Office Equipment ✅ Prepare and manage Approval Notes, Rate Contracts, VORs, Purchase Orders, and Service Contracts. ✅ Drive vendor onboarding, performance evaluation, and relationship management. ✅ Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, HR, Finance, Legal, Projects, Customer Service, and Leadership teams to ensure timely delivery of business requirements. What We're Looking For ✔ Strong experience in Procurement & Strategic Sourcing ✔ Expertise in Commercial Negotiation and Contract Management ✔ Experience in Vendor Management and Procurement Operations ✔ Knowledge of RFQ/RFP processes, Purchase Orders, and Rate Contracts ✔ Hands-on experience with ERP/SAP procurement systems ✔ Strong stakeholder management and communication skills Location 📍 Gurgaon Why Join Us? Be part of a dynamic organization where you'll contribute to procurement excellence, cost optimization, and operational efficiency across multiple business functions and locations.
